summary: Staged removal of the note column from account_user: deploy new Saleor version with state_only migration to preserve schema during overlap, retire old version, then contract SQL stage drops the note column. Old version continues writing notes; new version's Django omits note from operations, preserving existing values. Runner checks validate consistency after each stage.
write_consistency: Old version's writes to note column continue uninterrupted as the column remains present; new version's Django models omit note, so INSERT/UPDATE statements exclude it, leaving existing note values unchanged. New rows receive the column's database default (NULL). Runner cross-version checks confirm note persistence matches most recent writes from either version.

stages.description: Drop the note column from account_user table after old version retirement.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
